title: On-Campus Accommodation vs. Private Tenancy
passage: Choosing between living in a university hall of residence and leasing a private off-campus apartment represents a pivotal financial decision for overseas scholars. On-campus dormitories generally include utility bills and broadband internet within a fixed termly fee, simplifying monthly budgeting. Conversely, private rentals often require personal utility contracts and substantial damage deposits. Nonetheless, private apartments provide greater privacy and independence, making them popular among postgraduate researchers with intensive laboratory schedules.
